measurement.aggregation: All repetitions; median wall time and sample standard deviation / mean. No samples discarded; no overhead subtraction.
measurement.timing: Complete steady workloads retain normal entries, checks, overflow semantics, roots, safepoints and automatic GC. Source preparation, compilation and warm-up are excluded. Reflection reload/resources separately includes compilation and publication.
measurement.native_free_jit_tier: Compiler::CompileOptions default Baseline; this suite has no optimized-tier case.

suite.identity: Complete workload C++/AOT/reloadable JIT comparison; native free calls; optimized native classes; full reflection

comparison.reason: Previous entry covers six AOT/C++ reflection workloads at five repetitions; current source and suite differ. Only same-run paired C++ ratios are reported.

reflection_compare.luajit_build: upstream amalgamation; default allocator; no FFI workloads

limitations: Machine was not affinity-pinned; normal desktop background processes remained active. All seven samples contribute to each median and CV.
A ratio is elapsed Vela time / same-run C++ time; smaller is faster. Each workload/size pair receives equal weight in geometric means.
Native free-call JIT uses the existing suite default Baseline tier; optimized and reload_optimized native-class results are identified separately.
Reflection C++ is a hand-registered hash-table/function-pointer reference with fixed receiver and integer signature; it omits Vela GC, reload, named/default arguments and general type checks.
Reflection ns/op is amortized over 128 operations, or eight for queries. Reload/resources reports per-publication time and includes compilation.
Managed allocation counters count Vela Heap allocations, not C++ allocations.

measurement.aggregation: All seven samples, median wall time and sample CV; no outliers discarded or overhead subtracted.
measurement.native_free_jit_tier: Existing suite default Baseline; auxiliary validator-required controls only.

suite.identity: Same-binary targeted remeasurement of every prior AOT/C++ ratio above 1.2, including reflection direct controls

comparison.reason: Full suite changed to a threshold-selected subset; do not compare aggregate geometric means. Shared case inputs, source, binaries, toolchain and measurement options are unchanged.

aot_compare.aot_codegen: LLVM O3; generic CPU; PIC; checked arithmetic; explicit roots

reflection_compare.luajit_build: upstream amalgamation; default allocator; no FFI workloads

limitations: The subset was selected from prior ratios above 1.2; it is not an unbiased summary of the full suite.
Case selection changes process preparation and interleaving context even with identical binaries and per-case inputs.
No CPU affinity; desktop background processes remained active. All samples retained.
Reflection direct controls are ordinary access/calls, not reflective dispatch. Their C++ loops can be optimized aggressively; keep them separate.
No historical executable was rebuilt. This rerun tests reproducibility on the same current code; it does not establish the cause of a source-code regression.
Two additional reflection confirmations use longer sampling (15 x 0.5s). Their statistics are retained separately and are not pooled with the seven-repetition primary comparison.

confirmation.reason: Primary cached-call C++ CV was 20.1%; type+member lookup ratio was within noise of 1.2. Increased sampling only for these two pairs.
